prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: additional 32x32 environment tile sprites for the existing white-ground heavy-dither top-down JRPG spike.
Input image: style reference only, earlier environmental sheet. Preserve its BLACK AND WHITE pixel texture aesthetic but improve small-screen readability.
IMPORTANT SCALE: native player is 16x16 pixels, entire visible play area 128x64 pixels. Each asset cell is 32x32 pixels. Trees fit one cell (twice player height), compact cottage uses two horizontal cells (64x32, four player widths and two player heights). No large 96x64 houses.
Generate ONE square sheet containing exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 16 cells. Native logical size 128x128, each cell exactly32x32, enlarged crisp pixel art. No gutters, borders, labels or outer margins. Render chunky logical pixels, not fine illustration. White background, monochrome black and white only. Strong clean contours and white highlights; heavy controlled 1px checkerboard and clustered dithering inside foliage, water and roof material, not across open ground. Classic early Pokemon overhead camera, roofs/crowns from above and very short front faces, NOT isometric.
Exact row-major cells:
Row1: horizontal pale dirt walking path with central lane16px high and tiny pebble edges; vertical pale dirt path central lane16px wide; four-way intersection of these paths; elbow path turning from left edge to bottom edge.
Row2: water center with structured black ripples/dither on white; west bank with white land on left half and water on right half; east bank with water on left half and white land on right half; horizontal wooden footbridge over water, deck occupies ONLY center16px height and connects left/right edges.
Row3: compact cottage LEFT HALF; same cottage RIGHT HALF; small vegetable bed; wooden bench. The cottage MUST be ONE connected64x32 subject spanning first TWO cells with pitched roof above a short shallow facade, one16px doorway at bottom near middle, no extra story, no huge garden. Roof heavily dithered but door clear. White ground around cottage.
Row4: round broadleaf tree32px tall; horizontal connected hedge32px wide; small paired boulders; tiny wooden signpost.
Every prop grounded on white, no black rectangular backplates. Land half of bank tiles pure white. Path tiles clean and visually quiet. All assets reusable for a small village near a narrow river. Repeatable path and water edges aligned to cell boundaries. No people, no text, no logos, no gray or antialiasing.
